root_causes.title: Project container first heading is the only anchor; its rejection suppresses later body facts
evidence: p12/22 is the sole m123 project anchor, is_heading and eligible=false, so _admitted returns false.
m123 includes p12/28 4000kL but produces no candidate; no target withholding is reported. Cached p12/28 fact is absent at candidate return.
m124 admits only p12/29 as anchor; p12/30 100000L becomes context_only even though the shared analysis view contains both originals.
root_causes.neutral_red: Source-owned project with a generic non-factual heading and two complete independent operating body statements. A rejected heading must not certify that the body has no facts. A nearby future generic paragraph must not become a mandatory dependency without an actual source relation. Require same original IDs, own project scope and unchanged hard costs; no company or number reservation.

root_causes.title: Observed capacity volume and scoped revenue growth receive no meaningful metric relation
evidence: p14/8 native carrier contains ongoing small-molecule capacity, zero-defect site inspection and >4000kL, but source fact eligible=false/score0/purpose unknown.
p14/19 explicitly names safety-evaluation business and revenue YoY+4.6%, but source fact eligible=false/score0/purpose unknown.
Both admitted only by operating_metrics section, become description with value=1 and exact key-level budget_full; every selected anchor is value=0 meaningful_fact.
root_causes.neutral_red: Test named equipment total vessel volume already increased to >8200kL and named support-service revenue YoY+6.3% as distinct observed source relationships. Pair with vessel ID/date/currency, financial total, other actor, hypothetical and unknown controls. Preserve unit and growth-rate denominator; do not label forecasts as actual stocks.

root_causes.title: Distinct operating facts collapse into one coarse core_business competition
evidence: R42万/310, Biology20%, guidance, condition and peptide project all have score3, only core_business topic, repeated_signature=false, and complete closures.
All corresponding closure keys remain pending without being popped; each gets its own actual budget_full diagnostic from the cap-full short circuit.
core_business has41 visits at return. R/Biology/guidance priority2 compete behind priority1 within this seen topic; peptide priority1 carries4 unique spans including two general future paragraphs.
root_causes.neutral_red: A bounded synthetic fixture should distinguish two independent source scopes and relationship types that currently share core_business, retain true scope/qualifiers, and compare eligibility/rank metadata with an equal-cost generic description. Specify a finite coverage contract before asserting recall; do not require every real fact in96 or add oracle keywords.

root_causes.title: Forecast and explicit conditions are independent cards; the forecast cache contains actual/current business_scope
evidence: Guidance p14/32 native carrier and p14/34 conditions each have only MD&A/operating-results headings as required IDs; neither closure includes the other.
Condition antecedent window contains guidance originals, but no required-context edge is generated.

Forecast carrier cached relation is issuer/positive/current/actual business_scope; source numeric forecast is not represented as a forecast relation. Neither card was selected, so no wrong emitted summary is claimed.
root_causes.neutral_red: A neutral company forecasts next-year revenue range and continuing-business growth, followed by an explicit local assumption/noncommitment paragraph. Verify forecast/conditional states and dependency closure under tight slots, plus an independent nearby risk paragraph that must not be attached. Keep raw words and separate units unchanged.

limitations: Not all omitted facts must fit96. The observed cap and selection policy are not by themselves proof that every omission is a product bug.
p12 capacity original was never independently source-fact assessed in the observed candidate pass; no hypothetical fact result is substituted for that actual missing stage.
Guidance actual/current cache relation is a metadata observation on unselected material; no model call or summary error is claimed.
Preexisting code/types after the traced run are not automatically covered.
Neutral RED suggestions are designs, not executed failing tests.
